nodes.label: Tailwind CSS Responsive Design
nodes.rationale: Reference doc covering mobile-first breakpoints, responsive utilities, layouts, container queries, custom breakpoints, and best practices.

nodes.label: Mobile-First Approach
nodes.rationale: Base styles apply to all screen sizes, override at larger sizes using breakpoint prefixes (sm/md/lg/xl/2xl).

nodes.label: Breakpoint System
nodes.rationale: Default breakpoints: sm 640px, md 768px, lg 1024px, xl 1280px, 2xl 1536px via @media (min-width: ...).

nodes.label: Container Queries
nodes.rationale: Style elements based on parent container width using @container with @sm/@md/@lg/@xl/@2xl prefixes.

nodes.label: Custom Breakpoints
nodes.rationale: Define custom breakpoints in @theme (e.g. --breakpoint-3xl: 120rem, --breakpoint-tablet: 48rem) and use as tablet:/3xl: prefixes.

nodes.label: Card Grid Layout
nodes.rationale: Responsive layout pattern: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 md:gap-6.

nodes.label: Responsive Best Practices
nodes.rationale: Guidance: mobile-first design, consistent breakpoints, test at boundaries, use container for content width, progressive enhancement, 2-3 breakpoints per element.
